notes: Template has no reasoning_effort or reasoning_strength branch. All six effort values, plus reasoning.effort and thinking.effort, render byte-identically to the no-effort baseline, so effort is silently ignored and llama.cpp b11960 caps reports no effort levels. Thinking is toggled by enable_thinking; reasoning_effort "none" works only because the server maps it to enable_thinking=false. developer is accepted and rendered as a system turn. Tools use the Gemma 4 DSL. Header read from unsloth/gemma-4-E4B-it-GGUF/gemma-4-E4B-it-UD-IQ2_M.gguf.
